derivation: a primitive root; also interchangeable for H2820 (חָשַׂךְ)
def: to cling, i.e. join, (figuratively) to love, delight in; elliptically; to deliver
kjv: have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.

words.word: because he hath set his love

occurrences.text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
Only the Lord had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
And seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire unto her, that thou wouldest have her to thy wife;

And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
words: Because he hath set his love

occurrences.text: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
